chapter.title: Midnight Train
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 at flowchart-node level from the PowerPyx 100% chart (55 boxes, three phase labels, three endings) and the game’s text (detroitbecometext template and string table), with the Fandom wiki’s chapter, character and magazine pages. ARRIVE AT ROSE’S PLACE → trust Rose? → CHECK ON ALICE → INSIDE THE HOUSE → bedtime questions and KISS GOODNIGHT (Alice and Luther small up) → DRAW CURTAINS → TALK TO ROSE (CAUTIOUS / SINCERE, five topics, BORDER, INSIST / NO CHOICE) → the laundry room (LET / PREVENT ALICE SEEING MARY) → ROSE AND ADAM ARGUE → ROSE LEAVES TO FIND HELP → EXPLORE THE HOUSE (magazine and TV, Luther, Alice’s secret, the androids, the photo) → ADAM RETURNS and the Adam talk → COP AT THE DOOR → FIND AND HIDE EVIDENCE OF DEVIANTS (about 50 seconds as six actions) → MANAGE THE POLICEMAN (six prompts and the evidence he finds) → LUTHER DIED KILLING POLICEMAN, LUTHER DIED SAVING OTHER DEVIANTS or POLICEMAN LEFT (Alice and Luther small up). All 19 live template prompts are offered; the cut ones are not. No probability anywhere; the officer’s suspicion is a hidden counter because no source gives the meter’s values, and each rise adds a short qualitative cue to the outcome (story 1.9.2), as the player sees the meter fill. Cross-chapter: lutherWith in; luther / lutherWith and midnightOfficerDead out. Researched in docs/research/chapters/ch25-midnight-train.md.

decisions.title: Arrive at Rose’s Place (checkpoint), Meet Rose and Adam Outside, Luther and Alice Join Kara
decisions.context: November 8, 2038, 17:10. Kara, Alice and Luther reach Rose Chapman’s farm outside Detroit. Adam, chopping wood, tells Kara to go away; Rose comes out and invites them to talk inside.

options.label: Scripted, no choice
options.effect: Start checkpoint and two events; LUTHER AND ALICE JOIN KARA needs Luther alive (Zlatko).

decisions.gate: Chapter start, after Public Enemy; Kara’s route continues only if she escaped Zlatko’s house.
decisions.note: Chart nodes ARRIVE AT ROSE’S PLACE (checkpoint), MEET ROSE AND ADAM OUTSIDE, LUTHER AND ALICE JOIN KARA. No icon.

benchmark.note: One narrated event for the three nodes; the template’s lines. Every scene of the chapter is skipped, with a reason, if Luther is not with Kara (no released path).

decisions.title: Do you think we can trust ’em?
decisions.context: Luther, on the doorstep: “Do you think we can trust ’em?”

options.label: DISTRUST
options.effect: “If it feels wrong, we get out fast.” No stat change.

options.label: TRUST
options.effect: “We don’t have a choice…” No stat change.

decisions.gate: Luther alive (the Alice-asks variant is cut).
decisions.note: Template prompt; not a chart node. No arrow.

benchmark.note: Both labels in the template’s order.

decisions.title: Check on Alice (outside) or Enter the House
decisions.context: Before going in, Kara can talk to Alice: “I’m cold, Kara…”
decisions.note: Chart arrows CHECK ON ALICE (optional) and ENTER THE HOUSE.

benchmark.note: Offered once as a two-way choice.

decisions.title: Inside the House (checkpoint), Follow Adam to the Guest Room, Get Alice Ready for Bed
decisions.context: Rose: “She’s running a fever…” Adam shows them to the spare room upstairs.
decisions.note: Chart nodes INSIDE THE HOUSE (checkpoint), FOLLOW ADAM TO THE GUEST ROOM, GET ALICE READY FOR BED.

decisions.title: Bedtime questions
decisions.context: Alice in bed: “We can’t stop because of me…”, “Why do humans hate us?”, “Why can’t we just talk to each other?”
decisions.gate: Always. A fourth prompt (REASSURE / PROTECT / BRAVE, about the Jerrys) is marked cut.
decisions.note: Three live template prompts inside GET ALICE READY FOR BED.

benchmark.note: Three decision scenes with the template’s labels; the cut prompt is not built.

decisions.title: Goodnight: SUGGEST EATING, KISS GOODNIGHT or LEAVE
decisions.context: Rose brings “Rose’s world famous spaghetti” and something for Alice’s fever.

options.label: KISS GOODNIGHT
options.effect: Alice small up, Luther small up (template arrows; wiki Relationship Changes).

benchmark.note: KISS GOODNIGHT: aliceBond +1 and lutherTrust +1 (option effect).

decisions.title: Draw Curtains (guest room)
decisions.context: Before leaving the bedroom Kara can draw the curtains.
decisions.note: Chart arrow DRAW CURTAINS under GET ALICE READY FOR BED (the first of two DRAW CURTAINS nodes).

decisions.title: Luther Watches over Alice; Talk to Rose: CAUTIOUS or SINCERE
decisions.context: Luther: “I’ll stay with her a while.” Rose: “So, are you gonna tell me what a deviant’s doing in the snow with a little girl?”

options.label: CAUTIOUS
options.effect: “It’s a long story…” No stat change.

options.label: SINCERE
options.effect: Kara tells her about Todd. No stat change.

decisions.note: Chart event LUTHER WATCHES OVER ALICE and arrow TALK TO ROSE; the template’s first Rose prompt.

decisions.title: Ask Rose: WHY HELP?, MANY DEVIANTS?, DANGEROUS, ROSE, THANKS, then BORDER
decisions.context: Rose answers why she helps, how many androids come, why she takes the risk, about her family; on the border: “The only way is over the river…”

options.label: MANY DEVIANTS?
options.effect: More and more androids; unlocks DANGEROUS.

options.label: DANGEROUS
options.effect: The first android was shot at the border; locked until MANY DEVIANTS?.

options.label: ROSE
options.effect: Her husband died two years ago.

decisions.gate: Always; DANGEROUS needs MANY DEVIANTS? (template Lock).
decisions.note: Template topic prompt and single-option BORDER prompt.

benchmark.note: one repeatable clue hub: each offers the topics not yet asked plus BORDER; any number of topics can be asked (an assumption).

decisions.title: INSIST or NO CHOICE
decisions.context: Rose thinks they would be safer staying until things settle down.

options.label: INSIST
options.effect: Same line as NO CHOICE; no stat change.

options.label: NO CHOICE
options.effect: Same line as INSIST; no stat change.

decisions.note: Template prompt; both options print the same line.

decisions.title: Follow Rose to Laundry Room: Let Alice See Mary or Prevent Alice Seeing Mary
decisions.context: Mary has shut down; the android who loved her holds her. Alice comes downstairs: “I wasn’t sleepy…”

options.label: STAY (LET ALICE SEE MARY)
options.effect: Alice comforts him; opens CHECK ON ALICE by the fire.

options.label: TAKE ALICE OUTSIDE (PREVENT ALICE SEEING MARY)

decisions.note: Chart nodes FOLLOW ROSE TO LAUNDRY ROOM, ALICE APPROACHES MARY and the choice group; no stat change.

benchmark.note: Sets midnightSawMary, which gates the fireside INSIST / LET IT GO options.

decisions.title: Leave Laundry Room, Rose and Adam Argue, Rose Leaves to Find Help (checkpoint)
decisions.context: Adam: “We can’t hide them! … We’ll go to prison, Mom!” Rose goes to arrange the crossing: “You stay here, I won’t be long.”
decisions.note: Chart nodes LEAVE LAUNDRY ROOM, ROSE AND ADAM ARGUE, ROSE LEAVES TO FIND HELP.

decisions.title: Read Magazine and Watch News
decisions.context: Century, “World War Three”, with the Treat Yourself! advertisement inside, on the kitchen table; the news on the Stratford Tower attack on the TV.

options.label: READ MAGAZINE
options.effect: Required for CHANGE MAGAZINE COVER; reading the advertisement leaves the magazine open at it (evidence).

decisions.note: Chart arrows READ MAGAZINE and WATCH NEWS. No public-opinion effect.

benchmark.note: A media scene at the start of the phase; the magazine page carries into the hiding phase.

decisions.title: Explore the House: Talk to Luther, Check on Alice (INSIST / LET IT GO), Check on Deviants, See Family Photo
decisions.context: Luther: “There’s something I need to tell you… It’s about Alice.” “Not now, Luther.” Alice: “If I tell you, you won’t love me anymore…”

options.label: TALK TO LUTHER
options.effect: Kara cuts him off; no choice.

options.label: CHECK ON ALICE: INSIST
options.effect: Alice will not tell; only after LET ALICE SEE MARY.

options.label: CHECK ON ALICE: LET IT GO
options.effect: Only after LET ALICE SEE MARY.

decisions.gate: Optional; CHECK ON ALICE needs LET ALICE SEE MARY (wiki).
decisions.note: Free-roam phase [EXPLORE THE HOUSE]; no stat change.

benchmark.note: one repeatable clue hub; each offers what is left; the fireside prompt is folded into the approach.

decisions.title: Adam Returns; Talk to Adam to Lower Tension

options.label: CONFESS
options.effect: “Since I met Alice, I know I can feel things…” No stated effect.

decisions.note: Chart event ADAM RETURNS and optional arrow TALK TO ADAM TO LOWER TENSION; template prompt.

benchmark.note: An event, then the prompt with a fourth option for not talking. No effect on the officer is applied (none is sourced).

decisions.title: Cop at the Door: Find and Hide Evidence of Deviants
decisions.context: A policeman knocks. Adam panics. Kara has roughly 50 seconds to hide the evidence, tell Alice and Luther where to hide, calm Adam and open the door.

options.label: CHANGE MAGAZINE COVER
options.effect: Only after READ MAGAZINE; otherwise POLICEMAN SEES ARTICLE if the advertisement shows.

options.label: HIDE BLUE BLOOD POUCHES
options.effect: Otherwise POLICEMAN DISCOVERS THE BLUE BLOOD.

options.label: TELL ALICE & LUTHER TO HIDE: UPSTAIRS / LAUNDRY / KITCHEN
options.effect: Upstairs: a noise exposes them; kitchen needs the curtain drawn; not telling them leaves them in the kitchen.

options.label: DRAW CURTAINS or CURTAIN LEFT OPEN
options.effect: Kitchen only; left open is LUTHER DIED KILLING POLICEMAN.

options.label: SHUT THE DOOR OF LAUNDRY ROOM
OPEN THE DOOR or POLICEMAN INSISTS

decisions.note: Chart nodes COP AT THE DOOR, [FIND AND HIDE EVIDENCE OF DEVIANTS] (five items), the hiding-place and curtain groups, ADAM PANICS, REASSURED ADAM, OPEN THE DOOR / POLICEMAN INSISTS AND KARA HAS TO OPEN THE DOOR. No probability; the timer has no failure branch except the door.

benchmark.note: An event, then one repeatable clue hub: the 50 seconds as six actions before the door (unsourced budget); a seventh action means the officer insists. No risk roll.

decisions.title: Manage the Policeman
decisions.context: The officer comes in, accepts coffee and asks questions; what he finds and what Kara answers raise his suspicion; as he leaves he hears a noise from the laundry room.

options.label: ALICE / NOBODY (LIE ABOUT ALICE)
options.effect: NOBODY is exposed if they hid upstairs.

options.label: MESS / PREVIOUS OWNER / NOT MINE
options.effect: Only if the blue blood was found; NOT MINE raises suspicion.

options.label: MADE COFFEE
options.effect: Not making it raises suspicion (PowerPyx recipe).

options.label: DOG / WASHING MACHINE / WIND / HEARD NOTHING
options.effect: Decides POLICEMAN IS SUSPICIOUS or POLICEMAN FOOLED with the suspicion.

decisions.gate: After the door opens; ends early if the officer finds Luther in the kitchen.
decisions.note: Chart phase [MANAGE THE POLICEMAN]: LIE ABOUT ALICE, POLICEMAN SUSPICIOUS ABOUT UPSTAIRS, MADE COFFEE, POLICEMAN DISCOVERS ALICE & LUTHER HIDDEN, POLICEMAN SEES ARTICLE, POLICEMAN DISCOVERS THE BLUE BLOOD, POLICEMAN QUESTIONS ADAM, POLICEMAN SEES ANDROID CLOTHES; five template prompts. The game shows a suspicion meter; no source gives its values, and the sources disagree on the noise question.

benchmark.note: A hidden counter (one per item found, late door, exposed lie, NOT MINE, no coffee, UPSET, open laundry door) plus the noise answer (WASHING MACHINE 0, WIND 1, DOG 2, HEARD NOTHING 3); three or more is suspicious. Sizes unsourced.

decisions.title: Endings: Luther Died Killing Policeman, Luther Died Saving Other Deviants, Policeman Left
decisions.context: Three outcomes. In each, Rose returns: “Get yourselves ready. We leave tonight.”

options.label: LUTHER DIED KILLING POLICEMAN
options.effect: Kitchen, curtain left open (or never told to hide). Luther and the officer die. Cross-chapter impact.

options.label: LUTHER DIED SAVING OTHER DEVIANTS
options.effect: POLICEMAN IS SUSPICIOUS > COP FINDS ANDROIDS IN THE LAUNDRY ROOM. Luther and the officer die. Cross-chapter impact.

options.label: POLICEMAN LEFT
options.effect: POLICEMAN FOOLED. Alice small up, Luther small up.

decisions.note: Two ending tiles carry the cross-chapter-impact padlock; none has a skull. Luther’s death removes him from Crossroads and Battle for Detroit; the officer’s death turns Adam hostile at the border.

benchmark.note: midnightOutcome records the chart label; luther and lutherWith go false on both deaths; midnightOfficerDead is set for Battle for Detroit (not yet read there); POLICEMAN LEFT applies aliceBond +1 and lutherTrust +1.
